title: TCS Sydney Marathon 2026 course map
claims: The official 2026 course map marks the start and the finish and marks kilometres every 5 km.
The map key identifies drink stations providing water and electrolytes, and energy gel points.

The map's extractable text names North Sydney, McMahons Point, Kirribilli, Pyrmont, Ultimo, Sydney, Darlinghurst, Woolloomooloo, Surry Hills, Paddington, Woollahra, Kensington, Kingsford and Royal Randwick.
The map's extractable text contains no elevation figures and no per-segment distance or climb table.
